name: Tailcat Manager
author: Tailcat Manager
description: Graphical management for Tailcat (point-to-point WireGuard connectivity, no control plane) from the Omarchy bar: listener status, SSH, file transfer/sharing, SOCKS5 proxy + exit node, saved devices, identities, diagnostics.

barWidget.description: Start/stop the Tailcat listener, connect via SSH, transfer/share files, run a SOCKS5 proxy or exit node, and manage devices/identities/services.
